## Quarto

This figure pulls together simultaneous light exposure measurements from `glasses`, `chest`, and `wrist` wearing positions, as well as an `environmental` measurement of light exposure from a university rooftop (i.e., unobstructed, horizontal) in the same city as the participant. Data from `Didikoglu et al 2025` ([Github repository](https://github.com/MeLiDosProject/DidikogluEtAl_Dataset_2025)).

## Setup

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(ggdist)
library(gghighlight)
library(patchwork)
library(LightLogR)
library(legendry)
library(figpatch)
library(cowplot)
#collecting general parameters
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeLiDosProject/Data_Metadata_Conventions/main/scripts/general_parameters.R")
site <- "IZTECH"
```

### Import light

```{r}
positions <- c("chest", "glasses", "wrist")
# URL for the raw RData file on GitHub
urls <- paste0("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeLiDosProject/DidikogluEtAl_Dataset_2025/main/data/imported/light/light_", positions, "_1minute.RData")
urls <- map(urls, base::url)
walk(urls, load, envir = globalenv())

#combine light data
data <- join_datasets(light_wrist_1min, light_glasses_1min, light_chest_1min)
rm(light_wrist_1min, light_glasses_1min, light_chest_1min)
```

### Import sleep data & wear log

```{r}
load(url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeLiDosProject/DidikogluEtAl_Dataset_2025/main/data/imported/continuous/sleepdiaries.RData"))
load(url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MeLiDosProject/DidikogluEtAl_Dataset_2025/main/data/imported/continuous/wearlog.RData"))
```

### Join sleep-wake-data

```{r}
sleepdiary <-
  sleepdiary |> 
  select(Id, sleep, wake) |> 
  group_by(Id) |> 
  pivot_longer(-Id, names_to = "sleep", values_to = "Datetime") |> 
  sc2interval(Statechange.colname = sleep, starting.state = "wake") |> 
  sleep_int2Brown(Brown.day = "wake", Brown.evening = "pre-sleep", Brown.night = "sleep") |> 
  mutate(sleep = case_when(is.na(sleep) & State.Brown == "pre-sleep" ~ "wake", 
                           .default = sleep))

wearlog <-
  wearlog |>  select(Id, start, end, wear = state)

data <- 
data |> 
  add_states(sleepdiary, start.colname = Interval, end.colname = Interval) |> 
  add_states(wearlog)
```

## Visualization

```{r}
data_reduced <- 
  data |> 
  filter(Id == "IZTECH_S015") |> 
  group_by(Id, position) |>
  aggregate_Datetime("15 mins") |> 
  filter_Date(start = "2025-05-02", length = "1 day") |> 
  group_by(Id) |>
  mutate(wear = case_when(wear == "off" ~ "non-wear", .default = wear),
         State.Brown = factor(State.Brown, levels = c("wake", "pre-sleep", "sleep")),
         position = factor(position, levels = c("glasses", "chest", "wrist"))) |> 
  add_photoperiod(coordinates[[site]])
```

```{r}
fig_path <- function(labels) {
        paste0("assets/wearables_", labels, ".png")
}
```

```{r}
figs <- 
  c("glasses","chest", "wrist") |> 
  map(fig_path) |> 
  map(fig)
```


```{r}
Plot1 <-
 data_reduced |>
  gg_day(geom = "line", group = position, linewidth = 1) |> 
  gg_photoperiod() |>
  gg_states(State.Brown, aes_fill = State.Brown, ymax = -0.1, ymin = -0.4, alpha = 1, on.top = TRUE) |>
  gg_states(wear, aes_fill = wear, ymax = -0.1, ymin = -0.4, alpha = 1, on.top = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = 
                      c(wake = "#6A9FB5",
                        `pre-sleep` = "#FDB863",
                        sleep = "#2C3E50",  
                        `non-wear` = "red")) +
  labs(fill = "Status") +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  facet_wrap(~position, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
   gghighlight(use_direct_label = FALSE) +
   guides(fill = "legend", col = "none") +
theme(
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.placement = "outside",
        legend.position = "bottom"
)
Plot1
```

```{r}
 data_reduced |>
  cut_Datetime(unit = "2 hours", type = "floor", group_by = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(
    State.Brown = factor(names(which.max(table(State.Brown, useNA = "ifany")))),
    State.Brown.cut = interaction(State.Brown, Datetime.rounded),
         ) |> 
  filter(position == "chest") |> 
  gg_day(geom = "line", linewidth = 1) |> 
  gg_states(State.Brown.cut, aes_fill = State.Brown, ymax = median, 
            alpha = 1, 
            extract.metric = 
              list(
                median = ~exp_zero_inflated(mean(log_zero_inflated(MEDI))),
                State.Brown = ~State.Brown
                )
            ) |> 
    gg_photoperiod() +
  # gg_states(wear, aes_fill = wear, ymax = -0.1, ymin = -0.4, alpha = 1, on.top = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = 
                      c(wake = "#6A9FB5",
                        `pre-sleep` = "#FDB863",
                        sleep = "#2C3E50",  
                        `non-wear` = "red")) +
  labs(fill = "Status") +
    cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  # facet_wrap(~position, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
   gghighlight(use_direct_label = FALSE) +
   guides(fill = "legend", col = "none") +
theme(
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.placement = "outside",
        legend.position = "bottom"
)

```


```{r}
Plot2 <- 
data_reduced |> 
  filter(is.na(wear)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = State.Brown, y = MEDI, fill = State.Brown, col = State.Brown)) +
  geom_dots(side = "right", binwidth = unit(c(1.25, Inf), "mm"), scale = 0.6,
            overflow = "keep") +
  stat_slabinterval(normalize = "xy", side = "topleft",
                    interval_color = "black",
                    interval_alpha = 1,
                    point_alpha = 1,
                    point_color = "black",
                    point_fill = "black",
                    scale = 0.6) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "symlog", breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = 
                      c(wake = "#6A9FB5",
                        `pre-sleep` = "#FDB863",
                        sleep = "#2C3E50",  
                        `non-wear` = "red")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = 
                      c(wake = "#6A9FB5",
                        `pre-sleep` = "#FDB863",
                        sleep = "#2C3E50",  
                        `non-wear` = "red")) +
  facet_wrap(~position, ncol = 1, strip.position = "left") +
  guides(fill = "none", col = "none") +
  labs(y = "Melanopic EDI (lx)", x = NULL) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.4, NA))

Plot2
```

```{r}
key <- key_range_auto(sep = "\\.")

data_reduced |> 
  filter(is.na(wear)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = MEDI, y = fct_rev(interaction(position, State.Brown)), fill = State.Brown, col = State.Brown)) +
  stat_slab(normalize = "xy", side = "topleft",
                    interval_color = "black",
                    interval_alpha = 1,
                    point_alpha = 1,
                    slab_color = "black",
                    point_color = "black",
                    point_fill = "black",
                    height = 2) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "symlog", breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = 
                      c(wake = "#6A9FB5",
                        `pre-sleep` = "#FDB863",
                        sleep = "#2C3E50",  
                        `non-wear` = "red")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = 
                      c(wake = "#6A9FB5",
                        `pre-sleep` = "#FDB863",
                        sleep = "#2C3E50",  
                        `non-wear` = "red")) +
  guides(fill = "none", col = "none", y = primitive_bracket(key = key)) +
  labs(y = "Melanopic EDI (lx)", x = NULL) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside")
```
